title: Car vs cyclist, call 1 of 2 (witness)

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: There's been an accident, a car hit a cyclist! At the roundabout, Getingevägen and Byggmästaregatan, in Lund.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Getingevägen and Byggmästaregatan. Are you safe, are you off the road?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes I'm on the pavement. The guy on the bike flew over the hood, he's on the ground.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Is he moving? Is he talking?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: No, he's not moving. There's blood coming from his head. He doesn't have a helmet.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Is he breathing? Can you see his chest moving?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I... I think so, yes, he's making sounds. Like groaning.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: I'm sending ambulance and police. How many people are injured? Is the driver okay?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: The driver got out, she's walking around on the phone. I think it's just the cyclist.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Don't move him. If there's a lot of bleeding, press a jacket or cloth on it. Is anyone directing traffic?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Some people stopped. Okay, I'll press on it.

gold_label.urgency_rationale: Cyclist thrown over car, no helmet, head bleeding, not moving, only groaning (reduced consciousness).
